title: OwnTV layout
description: Home screen layout for the OwnTV Android TV launcher. Generated from the Kotlin model; do not edit by hand.

LayoutDocument.description: An OwnTV launcher layout. The screen is 960 x 540 dp; all sizes are in dp.

name.description: Name shown in launcher settings and layout history.

description.description: One sentence about this layout, shown in the template and theme lists.

theme.description: Colors, fonts, corner radius and focus style used by all widgets.

background.description: Background behind every page. Default: the theme background color.

styles.description: Named sets of node properties. A node uses one with "style": "name"; its own properties win. A style may itself set "style" to build on another one.

additionalProperties.description: Node properties (any property a node accepts, except type, id and children).

defaults.description: Default properties per node type, e.g. {"app_row": {"spacing": 24}}. Applied before styles; the node's own properties win.

additionalProperties.description: Node properties (any property a node accepts, except type, id and children).

apps.description: Per-app settings keyed by package name: label, artwork, hero backdrop and description.

pageTabs.description: Show a row of page tabs at the top when there is more than one page. Default false.

pages.description: Pages of the launcher. The first page is the home page.

Theme.description: Visual theme shared by all widgets.

colors.description: Named colors. Reference them anywhere a color is expected as "@name", e.g. "@primary".

cornerRadius.description: Default corner radius of tiles in dp. Default 12.

fontFamily.description: Font family for all text. Default sans.

fontScale.description: Multiplier for all text sizes. Default 1.

scrollMotion.description: How scrolling rows and columns move to the focused item. Containers can set their own. Default: a quick spring that keeps up with a held remote.

ThemeColors.description: Theme color tokens. Values must be hex colors (#RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB).

surface.description: Token @surface: tile and card background. Default #1F2229.

focus.description: Token @focus: focus border and glow color. Default #FFFFFF.

custom.description: Extra named colors, e.g. {"accent2": "#FF8800"}, usable as "@accent2".

FocusStyle.description: Look of the focused tile. D-pad focus must always be clearly visible on a TV.

scale.description: Scale of the focused tile. Default 1.08.

borderWidth.description: Border width in dp around the focused tile; 0 for none. Default 3.

borderColor.description: Border color of the focused tile. Default @focus.

glow.description: Soft glow or shadow around the focused tile. Default true.

glowColor.description: Glow color; use a dark, semi-transparent color like #99000000 for a drop shadow. Default: the border color at 55% opacity.

highlight.description: Draw a moving light sheen across the focused tile, like the tvOS focus effect. Default false.

motion.description: Movement of the focused tile: none, or sway (a gentle 3D tilt, like tvOS parallax). Default none.

ScrollMotion.description: How a scroll container moves to the focused item.

curve.description: spring (quick, keeps up with a held remote), ease_out (starts fast, glides to a stop), ease_in_out (gentle start and stop) or linear. Default spring.

duration.description: About how long one scroll takes, in milliseconds. Longer is slower and softer. Default 120.

Background.description: A color string (shorthand for a solid color) or a gradient or image object.

oneOf.description: A solid color: #RRGGBB, #AARRGGBB or a theme token like @surface.

colors.description: Two or more colors, from start to end.

angle.description: Direction in degrees, CSS style: 0 = bottom to top, 90 = left to right, 180 = top to bottom. Default 180.

src.description: Image location: an https:// URL or "asset:<path>" for an image bundled with the app.

dim.description: Darkens the image so text stays readable: 0 = none, 1 = black. Default 0.3.

blur.description: Blur radius in dp (Android 12 and newer). Default 0.

fit.description: How the image fills the area. Default cover.

Background.glass.description: Frosted Liquid Glass: blurs and refracts the hero, images and page background behind the node, with a light rim. Android 12 and newer; older devices show the tint only.

tint.description: Tint over the glass; use a translucent color. Default #1FFFFFFF.

variant.description: regular = frosted, clear = mostly see-through with stronger refraction. Default regular.

AppOverride.description: Settings for one app, used everywhere the app appears.

label.description: Name to show instead of the app's own.

banner.description: Image replacing the app's banner on banner and card tiles: an https:// URL or "asset:<path>".

icon.description: Image replacing the app's icon on icon tiles.

backdrop.description: Large image a hero shows while this app is focused.

description.description: Text a hero shows while this app is focused.

color.description: Tile background color behind the app's artwork.

Page.description: One full screen of the launcher.

id.description: Unique page id, used by go_to_page actions.

initialFocus.description: Id of the node that gets focus when the page opens. Default: the first focusable widget.

background.description: Background for this page only. Overrides the layout background.

root.description: Root node. It fills the whole 960 x 540 dp screen.

Node.description: A layout node. The "type" field selects the widget or container.

Node.column.description: Stacks children vertically, top to bottom.

spacing.description: Gap between children in dp. Default 0.

contentAlign.description: Horizontal alignment of children. Default start.

arrange.description: Vertical distribution of children. Default start.

scroll.description: Scroll vertically when the content is taller than the column. The focused widget scrolls into view. Default false.

scrollAlign.description: Where a focused child is scrolled to: nearest (just into view), start (to the top, minus scrollMargin) or center. Default nearest.

scrollMargin.description: Distance in dp from the top kept when scrollAlign is start. Default 32.

scrollMotion.description: How the column scrolls to the focused child. Default: the theme's scrollMotion.

width.description: "fill" (all available width), "wrap" (fit content) or a number in dp. Default depends on the widget.

height.description: "fill" (all available height), "wrap" (fit content) or a number in dp. Default depends on the widget.

weight.description: Share of the remaining space inside a row or column, like CSS flex-grow.

padding.description: Inner padding in dp: a number, [horizontal, vertical] or [start, top, end, bottom].

background.description: Background behind this node: a color like "#202020" or "@surface", or a gradient or image object.

cornerRadius.description: Corner radius in dp of the background, border and shadow.

opacity.description: Opacity of the whole node, 0 to 1. Default 1.

unfocusedOpacity.description: Opacity of the whole node while focus is not inside it, e.g. 0.5 dims every section except the focused one (Projectivy style). Default: no dimming.

shadow.description: Drop shadow size in dp. Default none.

align.description: Position inside the parent. In a stack all 9 values apply; in a column only the horizontal part is used; in a row only the vertical part.

span.description: Number of grid columns this node covers. Only used inside a grid. Default 1.

style.description: Name of an entry in the document's styles. Its properties apply where this node does not set its own.

focus.description: Where the D-pad goes from this node: ids of other nodes on the same page. On a container it applies when focus leaves the container in that direction.

revealOnFocus.description: When something inside this node gets focus, scroll so the whole node is visible (like the Apple TV top shelf). Default false.

showWhenFocused.description: Id of a node on the same page: this node is only shown (and takes space) while focus is inside that node, e.g. the name and description of the focused tile under its section. Default: always shown.

keepSpace.description: With showWhenFocused: keep the node's space while it is hidden and only fade it in and out, so nothing around it moves when focus changes. While the watched node has nothing to focus (an empty row) it takes no space. Default false (the node collapses).

visible.description: Set to false to hide the node without deleting it. Default true.

FocusLinks.description: Explicit D-pad targets. Each value is the id of a node on the same page.

up.description: Node that gets focus when Up is pressed.

down.description: Node that gets focus when Down is pressed.

left.description: Node that gets focus when Left is pressed.

right.description: Node that gets focus when Right is pressed.

TileStyle.description: Look of app, folder and shortcut tiles.

shape.description: banner = 16:9 app banner; icon = square app icon with the label below; card = banner with the label always below. Default banner.

size.description: small, medium or large. Banner widths: 128, 160, 208 dp. Icon sizes: 56, 72, 96 dp. Default medium.

showLabel.description: When to show the app name: always, focused or never. Default focused for banners, always for icon and card.

width.description: Exact tile width in dp; overrides size.

aspectRatio.description: Width divided by height, e.g. 1.78 (16:9), 1.67 (Apple TV 5:3), 1 (square), 0.67 (poster). Default 16:9, or 1 for icons.

cornerRadius.description: Corner radius in dp; overrides the theme's cornerRadius.

rim.description: Thin light edge around the tile, like tvOS Liquid Glass icons. Default false.

Node.app_row.description: A horizontally scrolling row of app tiles with an optional title. Default width fill.

titleIcon.description: Icon before the title: a shortcut icon name such as tv or smartphone, or an emoji.

tile.description: Tile look. Default banner, medium, label on focus.

spacing.description: Gap between tiles in dp. Default 16.

skip.description: Leave out the first N apps of the source, e.g. the ones a dock row above already shows. Default 0.

missing.description: For a list source: what to show for apps in the list that are not installed. Default hide.

scrollAlign.description: Where the focused tile is scrolled to: nearest, start (Google TV style, focused tile stays at the left) or center. Default nearest.

scrollMargin.description: Distance in dp of the focused tile from the row's left edge when scrollAlign is start. Default 0 (in line with the title).

scrollMotion.description: How the row scrolls to the focused tile. Default: the theme's scrollMotion.

AppSource.description: Which apps a row or grid shows.

sort.description: Order of the apps: custom (default: the order arranged on the TV, apps never moved follow alphabetically), alphabetical or recently_installed.

includeNonTvApps.description: Also show phone apps that have no TV launcher entry. Default false.

AppSource.category.description: Installed TV apps of one category.

category.description: games = apps marked as games; apps = everything that is not a game; mobile = phone apps sideloaded onto the TV (no TV launcher entry).

sort.description: Order of the apps. Default alphabetical.

AppSource.list.description: A named app list such as "favorites". The layout only names the list; the TV stores which apps are in it and in what order, and you add, remove and move apps with a long press. Lists with the same name share their apps, so switching layouts keeps them.

list.description: List name, e.g. "favorites", "games" or "kids". Letters, digits, _ and -.

AppSource.recent.description: Recently used apps, most recent first. Launches from OwnTV always count; with usage access granted, launches from anywhere count.

focus.description: Where the D-pad goes from this node: ids of other nodes on the same page. On a container it applies when focus leaves the container in that direction.

revealOnFocus.description: When something inside this node gets focus, scroll so the whole node is visible (like the Apple TV top shelf). Default false.

showWhenFocused.description: Id of a node on the same page: this node is only shown (and takes space) while focus is inside that node, e.g. the name and description of the focused tile under its section. Default: always shown.

keepSpace.description: With showWhenFocused: keep the node's space while it is hidden and only fade it in and out, so nothing around it moves when focus changes. While the watched node has nothing to focus (an empty row) it takes no space. Default false (the node collapses).

visible.description: Set to false to hide the node without deleting it. Default true.

Action.description: What happens when a focusable widget is clicked.

Action.go_to_page.description: Switches to another page of this layout.

Action.intent.description: Starts an Android activity intent. Needs at least one of action, package or component.

Action.open_app_drawer.description: Opens the built-in list of all installed apps.

Action.open_input.description: Switches the TV to one of its inputs, e.g. HDMI 1. Only TVs have inputs; streaming boxes show a message.

Action.open_launcher_settings.description: Opens OwnTV's own settings (import, templates, history, Android settings). Every layout needs at least one visible shortcut with this action, or it is rejected.

Action.open_url.description: Opens a URL with whatever app handles it (deep links work too).

Node.hero.description: A large banner area. With follow "focus" it shows the focused app (Apple TV top shelf); with "slides" it rotates through slides (Google TV / Fire TV carousel). Default width fill, height 280.

follow.description: focus = show the focused app or shortcut (backdrop and description come from the apps map or the shortcut); slides = rotate through slides. Default focus.

target.description: With follow focus: only react to focus inside the node with this id (e.g. the dock row). Default: the whole page.

slides.description: Slides. With follow focus they are shown until something is focused.

showText.description: Show title and description text. Default true.

scrim.description: Darkness of the gradient behind the text, 0 to 1. Default 0.6.

contentAlign.description: Where the text block sits. Default bottom_start.

fade.description: Share of the height at the bottom that fades out into what is behind the hero, 0 to 1. Default 0.

width.description: "fill" (all available width), "wrap" (fit content) or a number in dp. Default depends on the widget.

height.description: "fill" (all available height), "wrap" (fit content) or a number in dp. Default depends on the widget.

weight.description: Share of the remaining space inside a row or column, like CSS flex-grow.

padding.description: Inner padding in dp: a number, [horizontal, vertical] or [start, top, end, bottom].

background.description: Background behind this node: a color like "#202020" or "@surface", or a gradient or image object.

cornerRadius.description: Corner radius in dp of the background, border and shadow.

opacity.description: Opacity of the whole node, 0 to 1. Default 1.

unfocusedOpacity.description: Opacity of the whole node while focus is not inside it, e.g. 0.5 dims every section except the focused one (Projectivy style). Default: no dimming.

shadow.description: Drop shadow size in dp. Default none.

align.description: Position inside the parent. In a stack all 9 values apply; in a column only the horizontal part is used; in a row only the vertical part.

font.description: Font family. Default: the theme's font.

uppercase.description: Show the text in capital letters. Default false.

letterSpacing.description: Extra space between letters in sp.

textAlign.description: Alignment of the text inside its box. Default start.

maxLines.description: Maximum number of lines; longer text ends with an ellipsis.

icon.description: Icon before the text, in the text's size and color: a shortcut icon name such as tv or input, or an emoji.
